meta.name: cqrs-implementation
meta.description: Implement Command Query Responsibility Segregation for scalable architectures. Use when separating read and write models, optimizing query performance, or building event-sourced systems.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实现CQRS架构，分离读写模型以提升系统扩展性
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在设计或重构后端架构,需要分离读写模型来应对高并发查询。
copy.tagline_en: Implement CQRS to separate read and write models for scalable architectures.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're designing or refactoring backend architecture to handle high-concurrency reads and writes.

howto.what: 按 CQRS 模式帮你拆开读写：写走 Command 与 Command Handler，读走 Query 与 Query Handler，用事件和 Projector 同步读模型，并给出架构图、组件表与注意事项清单。
howto.when: 当你要分离读写模型、优化查询性能或构建事件溯源系统时接管。

howto.what_en: Splits reads from writes CQRS-style: writes via Commands and Command Handlers, reads via Queries and Query Handlers, with events and Projectors syncing the read model. Outputs an architecture diagram and component table.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you separate read and write models, optimize query performance, or build event-sourced systems.
